summary: Implemented the S3 Expires customization in the botocore repo. Changes: (1) botocore/parsers.py: BaseRestParser._parse_non_payload_attrs now routes the Expires header through a new _parse_expires_header helper, which always stores the raw value as ExpiresString and, if timestamp parsing fails (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError), logs a warning and omits Expires instead of raising. (2) botocore/data/s3/2006-03-01/service-2.json: added shape ExpiresString (string), a synthetic ExpiresString member on GetObjectOutput and HeadObjectOutput (the only S3 output shapes with Expires), and deprecation wording in the Expires member docs. (3) Added changelog entry .changes/next-release/feature-s3-expires-00000.json (rename the placeholder number before opening the PR). Verification was by reading only; no tests or repo code were run, and nothing was committed.
